selected_inputs: the registers and the D27 evidence of F5/F6
the D27 record texts (handoff, readme, schema, environment map)

args: node tests/manifest/build-manifest.mjs --components tests/manifest/components.json --graph design/environment-map/graph.json --rev 8a23c08b57ef6a174107fc8a3b55a2bdd43b71d0 --delta D27-FOUNDATION-CLOSURE-ALIGNMENT --epoch D27 --out design/execution-manifest

T=$(mktemp -d) && node tests/manifest/build-manifest.mjs --components tests/manifest/components.json --graph design/environment-map/graph.json --rev 8a23c08b57ef6a174107fc8a3b55a2bdd43b71d0 --delta D27-FOUNDATION-CLOSURE-ALIGNMENT --epoch D27 --out $T >/dev/null && cmp $T/manifest.json design/execution-manifest/manifest.json && cmp $T/CURRENT-EXECUTION-MANIFEST.md design/execution-manifest/CURRENT-EXECUTION-MANIFEST.md && echo 'manifest deterministic (rebuilt byte-identically)'

T=$(mktemp -d) && node tests/closure/structural-check.mjs --registers tests/closure/registers --components tests/manifest/components.json --graph design/environment-map/graph.json --facts-spec tests/envmap/facts/D27.json --root . --evidence-required --render design/foundation-closure/CLOSURE-REGISTERS.md --out $T/structural-check.json && node tests/closure/structural-check.mjs --registers tests/closure/registers --components tests/manifest/components.json --graph design/environment-map/graph.json --facts-spec tests/envmap/facts/D27.json --root . --evidence-required --render $T/registers-2.md --out $T/structural-check-2.json >/dev/null && cmp $T/registers-2.md design/foundation-closure/CLOSURE-REGISTERS.md && grep -q '^STRUCTURAL CHECK: PASS' design/foundation-closure/CLOSURE-REGISTERS.md && echo 'registers rendered deterministically with every evidence path present'

grep -q '^closure epoch' design/environment-map/SCHEMA.md && grep -q '^D27 ' design/environment-map/ENVIRONMENT-MAP.md && grep -q 'last delta         D27-FOUNDATION-CLOSURE-ALIGNMENT' docs/HANDOFF.md && grep -q '^current target     design/foundation-closure/FOUNDATION-CLOSURE-TARGET.md' docs/HANDOFF.md && grep -q 'FC-1 D28-SEED-BROKER-QUALIFICATION' docs/HANDOFF.md && grep -q 'S-LANGUAGE-LAW' docs/HANDOFF.md && grep -q 'FOUNDATION-CLOSURE-TARGET' README.md && echo 'record texts delivered'
